style.styleTitle: Personalised Kennel With Photo Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised dog Christmas bauble featuring a photo of your furry friend in a little wooden kennel. The perfect gift for a dog owner this Christmas. Add your own photo for inside the kennel and personalise with your dog s name on the plaque above. The cute wooden kennel sits in a flurry of artificial snow, encased in a glass bauble. Baubles measure 10cm and are finished with velvet ribbon in your choice of colour. Dimensions(mm): Height: 110 Width: 110 Depth: 110.
